subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB489
title: Directs the Legislative Administrator to cause updates to the Oregon Legislative Information System to permit amendments and informational material to be posted and associated online with a legislative measure without regard to whether the measure is scheduled for a hearing.
headline: SB 489 did not pass

claims.text: SB 489 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 489 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
